access_method: Ordinary HTTP GET of the public metadata API invoked by the HLMA download-page client bundle; the 13,050-byte JSON response is saved and SHA-256 pinned. Portal file_path IDs were compared with official NGDC OMIX release-page titles/counts/sizes. No dataset archives or processed objects were requested.
inventory_scope: 23 targeted processed object rows (snRNA count, peak-matrix, scRNA count, H5AD); portal archive URL/ID only, no archive/member identity claim.
limitations: All archive IDs and URLs are taken from the portal API file_path field; no archive bytes or archive members were downloaded or verified.

Four fragment rows point to P-sample OMIX records whose official titles name different samples; four archive groups also have portal-row/release sample-count differences. Do not infer aliases or missing/duplicated files.
The previously noted P27/P17 and snRNA-China title/size discrepancies remain unresolved. Myofiber_sn_RNA.h5ad (560M) maps to an OMIX record titled for Myonucleus (6.01 GB).

Three H5AD listing rows share one OMIX004308-01 archive path; exact file-member identities remain unresolved. Broad FAPs/Stromal and All-CellType/Skeletal-muscle label compatibility does not prove identity.
